title.narrative: Building the capacity of the Lebanese Palestinian Dialogue Committee (LPDC) to enhance the Lebanese response to the Palestinian refugee presence in Le

description.narrative: Enhance the capacity of the Lebanese Palestinian Dialogue Committee (LPDC) to effectively coordinate and address the Palestinian refugee file in Lebanon. Building the LPDC’s institutional capabilities, developing socio-economic and governance reform projects, and fostering dialogue between Palestinian and Lebanese stakeholders. By addressing immediate and long-term needs, including security and compliance with UNSCR 1701, the project seeks to promote sustainable development and strengthen the LPDC's role in managing post-conflict challenges.

The intended beneficiaries are the Palestinian and Lebanese communities, prioritized through direct consultations and a people-centered approach to address their needs and rights. Public sector stakeholders, UNRWA, international partners, and select civil society organizations also benefit through enhanced coordination, service delivery reforms, and strategic partnerships. These efforts aim to improve governance, transparency, and collaborative solutions for Palestinian-related issues in Lebanon.

This project aims to alleviate ongoing struggles faced by both the host country, Lebanon, and the Palestinian refugee community in Lebanon, which has been living without a clear future while being socioeconomically marginalized for decades. The foundational pillar of this project is capacity enhancement for the LPDC to enable the LPDC to develop the capability to be a direct recipient of grant aid by 1st April 2026. During the inception phase of the project (to 31st March 2025) ARK will conduct an organizational needs assessment and gap analysis on behalf of the Danish Embassy. By subsequently undertaking a comprehensive capacity building program and adopting a ‘learning by doing’ approach to organizational development, the project will position the LPDC to optimize its role in ‘day after’ scenarios.
